summary: The client has gone dark. Three messages landed in the whole week and all three were outbound automation: Stephski's Aug 1–14 invoice on Aug 15 (plus the PDF) and Michelle's weekly leak-removal report on Aug 17. Alex sent nothing — zero client messages, and nothing at all from either side after Aug 17. Her last word in this chat was 'Sent' on Aug 13. On an 11-month, 1,483-message account where she personally sent 846 messages, this is only the second zero-client week ever recorded, and the first was three weeks ago (week ending Aug 7). She has spoken on 3 of the last 21 days. Her monthly volume has fallen from 417 messages in Sep 2025 to 12 in Aug 2026. Nobody at ALTR noticed or reacted: not one person asked how she was, checked in, or followed up on anything owed to her. Everything that was outstanding on Aug 14 is still outstanding and has simply aged — Michelle's promise that posting on @paigealexxo would 'start this week' is now 24 days old with no proof ever sent, Derrek's 'in the next few hours' sales-team groupchat invite is 9 days unconfirmed, and the money ALTR owes her was never settled in writing. Layered on top, the Aug 15 invoice carried a changed account number and new Zelle details — the fourth change to ALTR's receiving bank details in 11 months, six weeks after Stephski wrote 'last change I promise!' — and it is sitting unacknowledged with payment due around Aug 22. The one benign explanation worth checking before anything else: Derrek said on Aug 12 that client groupchats were being created with the new sales team, so her conversation may simply have moved. Nobody has confirmed that either.

health.rationale: Down 23 points from 64. Last week's recovery did not hold: the client sent zero messages in the report week and has been silent since Aug 13 (8 days), the second zero-client week in three weeks on an account that has had only those two in 11 months. No ALTR person reached out during the silence — the only two team messages were the scheduled invoice and the scheduled DMCA report. Five commitments aged another week without movement (IG posting now 24 days overdue, groupchat invite 9 days, proactive updates 20 days), a new invoice is unacknowledged with a changed bank account number attached, and ALTR still owes her money with no written statement of the balance. Retained only because the DMCA and invoicing cadences did run on time and there is no hostile signal — she went quiet, she did not complain.
